title: Rigid Gift Box Buyer Checklist SourceBridge
buyer_questions: Should the gift box use magnetic, drawer, lid-and-base or folding structure?
What insert or tray should be reviewed before sampling?
Which surface finish should be compared for premium retail presentation?
What should be included in a rigid gift box RFQ before sampling?
rfq_fields: Insert, tray, divider or protection requirement
Surface finish reference and artwork readiness
Retail, gifting, ecommerce or display scenario
domestic_competitor_takeaway: Domestic factory sites often lead with structure and factory capability; MUGE should preserve clear magnetic/drawer/lid-base comparison for sourcing buyers.
overseas_competitor_takeaway: Overseas sites make premium gift packaging feel like a structure decision; MUGE should show sampling review questions before pushing contact.
avoid_points: Do not claim fixed MOQ, fixed lead time or lowest price.
Do not claim food-contact suitability, destination-market compliance or certification without document review.
Do not present unverified customer cases, factory scale, partnerships or platform badges as facts.
counting_boundary: This SourceBridge is public source-routing and buyer education evidence only. It is not proof of Google ranking, GSC clicks, GA4 traffic, AI natural recommendation, inquiry generation, customer case, endorsement, certification, fixed MOQ, fixed lead time or fixed price.
